_comment: Test vector for the grant of plan 004 (Noise_N_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256, Home Assistant initiator with an ephemeral key, tablet responder with its static key). The private keys are not stored: each is the SHA-256 of its seed text, as 32 raw bytes. The keys are fixture-only and never belong to a real tablet. The prologue is the bytes 'njorun/grant', 0x01 and the binding ID in UTF-8.
